stash.ours: Ours. Separate repo so it can be installed alone.

fast-jev-compaction.ours: Setup turns on function hooks (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1), which it needs.

quicksilver.ours: The tool rules tell Claude when to reach for it.

compact-adviser.ours: Setup installs it in auto mode; run /compact-adviser auto once to confirm. Uses the function hooks setup already turns on.

jev-steer-or-queue.ours: Our fork of Larkspur-Wang/Jev_steer_or_queue (see its UPSTREAM.lock.json): a Rust router (~90 ms per hook, works on Windows; upstream crashed there) with the Python one as fallback. Installed in shadow mode (logs decisions only); set its mode to active in /plugin to queue and stop for real.

rtk.ours: Setup installs it with its official installer and adds its Claude Code hook (rtk hook claude) for Bash and PowerShell.

codebase-memory.ours: The setup writes the rule that the graph misses callers with indirect types, so counts are confirmed with a text search.

webclaw.ours: Setup downloads its official release binaries into ~/.local/bin and registers webclaw-mcp with Claude Code (user scope). An existing webclaw registration (Docker, a custom path) is kept.
